Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrite positivity, and presence of bacteria and mucus. Glucosuria is noted, which may warrant further evaluation for hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low urine specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
